event.title: Barstool’s Chiclets Cup
event.description: Join Barstool Sports & Spittin’ Chiclet’s podcast personalities at the 2026 Chiclets Cup at Harpoon Brewery! FAQs Is the Chiclets Cup open to the public? Yes, everyone is welcome to watch the Chiclets Cup at the Harpoon Brewery. In addition to world-class street hockey, you can check out the sponsors, play games, enjoy Harpoon beer and other beverages (must be 21+ with proper ID to consume alcohol), and great food. Will there be food? Absolutely. We’ll have a range of food for all tastes. Is there an admission fee to attend the Chiclets Cup? No! It is free to attend. Do I have to be 21+ to attend? No, all ages are welcome! You must be 21+ with proper ID, however, to purchase and consume alcoholic beverages. Are Dogs Welcome? Unfortunately, not for this event. Can I sign up to play street hockey in the tournament? Registration is live here. Will the Spittin’ Chiclets podcast personalities be there? Yes, the entire cast will be on hand throughout the tournament!
